title: What is Carrier Global's targeted annual revenue from India by the decade's end?
explanation: Carrier Global targets US$1 billion in annual revenue from India by the decade's end.

title: Which infrastructure surge is driving the massive demand for Carrier's industrial cooling systems?
explanation: The surge in energy-dense data centres is driving high-capacity commercial climate control demand.

title: What does HVAC stand for in the context of Carrier Global's expertise?
explanation: HVAC stands for Heating, Ventilation & Air-Conditioning.

title: How much is Carrier investing in its new manufacturing facility in India?
explanation: Carrier is investing US$100 million in a new manufacturing facility in Sri City.

title: Where is Carrier's new manufacturing facility situated?
explanation: Carrier is investing US$100 million in Sri City, Andhra Pradesh.

title: What is one strategic geographical advantage of Sri City mentioned in the text?
options: It is within 100 kilometres of five sea ports
It has the largest airport in India
It is located in a cold climate zone
explanation: Sri City is strategically situated within 100 kilometres of five sea ports.

title: Which regions does Carrier plan to export to from its new Indian facility?
explanation: Sri City establishes an export engine for West Asia and Africa.

title: What type of imported equipment is Carrier aiming to phase out by localizing its supply chain?
explanation: Localizing production allows Carrier to phase out imported high-capacity chillers.

title: Beyond initial equipment sales, how is Carrier securing sustainable revenue?
options: Through recurring maintenance agreements and digital platforms
explanation: Sustainable revenue comes from recurring maintenance agreements, digital platforms, and system retrofits.

title: Which government framework is Carrier aligning with to optimize component procurement and lower import duties?
explanation: Localizing production under the "Make in India" framework optimizes procurement and duties.

title: Who are the primary clients for Carrier's multi-year lifecycle contracts?
explanation: Carrier embeds itself into multi-year contracts with hyperscalers, industrial developers, and commercial hubs.

title: What happens to server racks in energy-dense data centres when processing cloud applications?
explanation: Vast networks of server racks heat up in energy-dense data centres.

title: By what factor is India’s operational data centre capacity expanding?
explanation: India’s operational data centre capacity is expanding tenfold.

title: According to the text, what helps build defensible market positions for B2B industrial giants?
explanation: Embedding into multi-year lifecycle contracts builds defensible market positions.

title: For business and management graduates, what dynamic career pathway is highlighted as an alternative to tech startups?
explanation: Industrial and capital goods conglomerates provide dynamic career pathways beyond tech startups.

title: Which entry-level roles provide the highest career velocity for aspirants in this sector?
explanation: Real momentum comes from Client Acquisition, B2B Sales, and Client-Facing Partner Management.

title: What kind of interfaces are crucial for young professionals to negotiate high-value contracts?
options: Direct interface with facility developers and enterprise clients
explanation: Young professionals interface directly with facility developers, contractors, and enterprise clients.

title: What is the most effective starting point to position oneself for global capital goods leadership in the mid-to-long run?
options: Cross-functional and cross-industry roles at the local level
Joining a top consumer tech startup
Focusing solely on B2C social marketing
explanation: The most effective starting point is cross-functional and cross-industry at the local level.

title: Which of the following is recommended as a starting point for early career development in this sector?
options: Regional manufacturing companies or local dealerships
explanation: Begin by joining regional manufacturing companies, component suppliers, or local dealerships.

title: What type of expertise builds the ground-level credibility needed for enterprise leadership?
options: Localized supply chains and direct technical selling
explanation: Developing early expertise in localized supply chains and direct technical selling builds leadership credibility.

title: What is the overarching theme of Carrier's strategy in India?
options: Capitalizing on the AI/data centre boom through localized cooling solutions
Transitioning from B2B to B2C retail
Reducing product lifecycles to drive fast sales
explanation: Carrier is capitalizing on the AI/data centre infrastructure boom through localized high-capacity cooling.
